rules.name: Preserve recurring character identity
rules.enforcement: Preserve ID, face, age, body, hair, skin tone, proportions, clothing, footwear, head covering, accessories, and references.

rules.name: Enforce exact character count
rules.enforcement: Reject duplicate, extra, missing, swapped, lookalike, or morphed recurring characters unless explicitly required.

rules.name: Preserve creature and animal anatomy
rules.enforcement: Preserve identity, count, anatomy, size, surface, limbs, injury, saddle, tack, ropes, blankets, and equipment.

rules.name: Track prop possession and presence
rules.enforcement: Track owner, holder, position, orientation, damage, cleanliness, and presence; carried objects cannot disappear without an event.

rules.name: Preserve location geography
rules.enforcement: Preserve location ID, entrances, exits, architecture, routes, furniture, period, and spatial relationships; never blend locations.

rules.name: Persist injuries
rules.enforcement: Injuries retain body area, severity, visible wound, blood, behaviour, mobility effect, first sequence, and evolution until explicitly changed.

rules.name: Persist damage
rules.enforcement: Clothing, props, vehicles, buildings, creatures, and environmental damage persist until an explicit repair or state change.

rules.name: Preserve screen direction and action axis
rules.enforcement: Track camera side, direction, lens family, framing, height, movement, eyeline, and action axis; flag unexplained reversals.

rules.name: Preserve project visual language
rules.enforcement: Lock aspect ratio, colour, grain, contrast, saturation, highlights, blacks, sharpness, period feel, and lighting language.

rules.name: Preserve dialogue ownership
rules.enforcement: Track exact line, speaker, language, accent, voice age, delivery, and on/off-screen status; reject speaker swaps.

rules.name: Approved end state drives next start
rules.enforcement: Sequence N+1 START inherits Sequence N approved END plus approved assets and references, with explicit transitions only.

rules.name: Hard failures cannot hide behind score
rules.enforcement: A high aggregate score cannot approve an identity, count, required-reference, or lock failure.
